live_high_picks.text: Edmonton Oilers to win the money line against Detroit. Edmonton's 8-2-1 start and 49 goals in eleven games offer a stronger attacking foundation than Detroit's 4-4-3 record and 29 goals. There is a useful caution in the venue splits: the Oilers are only 3-2-1 at home, while the Red Wings are 1-1-2 away, so neither split supports treating this as a routine blowout. Both teams carry a one-game losing streak. Back Edmonton to win rather than extending the argument to a puck-line bet, where the evidence is less persuasive.
